pages.text: Operators (permission level 2) can run a contest with $(thing)/contest start [name]$(). Everyone is told it has begun, and from then on every two-way contact counts: two players who each heard the other within five minutes, as for the $(thing)First Contact$() advancement.$(br2)Talking on and on is one contact; working the same station again later is listed as a dupe.

pages.title: The report
pages.text: $(thing)/contest stop$() ends it and hands a $(item)Contest Report$() book to whoever stopped it and to every player in it who is online.$(br2)It names the winners (longest contact, most unique contacts, most biomes operated from and reached) and lists each player's contacts: frequency, mode and both heights.
